description: Set the stores the household shops at. This replaces the whole selection, so name every store they want; get_stores shows the ones chosen now. Bryti looks the names up near the household's address, and a name it does not find fails with the stores nearby.

address.description: Address the stores are near; omit when they are near the household's own address.

storeAddresses.description: Only for an undo: the address each store was found near, in the same order as storeNames.

items.description: An address the store at the same place in storeNames was found near.
A store name exactly as find_stores returned it.

name: select_stores
title: Choose stores
